summary: Backend refactor regression testing completed. Refactored code (routes_public, routes_admin, routes_payments, emailer) behaves identically to original. 90.5% backend pass rate (38/42 tests), 100% frontend pass rate (9/9 tests). Minor issue: visa-application-ae slug not found (data issue, not refactoring regression).

minor_issues.issue: Returns 404 - slug 'visa-application-ae' does not exist in system
minor_issues.impact: This is NOT a refactoring regression. The slug simply doesn't exist. Valid slugs are Turkish: '30-gun-tek-giris', '60-gun-tek-giris', etc. Tested with valid slug '30-gun-tek-giris' and it works correctly.
minor_issues.note: Review request mentioned testing this slug, but it's not a valid slug in the system. The refactored code works correctly with valid slugs.

passed_tests: POST /api/pricing/quote - store items (esim_1gb + ins_basic) with 10% bundle discount, validity dates (starts_on, ends_on, validity_days, covers_trip)
POST /api/applications - 2 travelers + store items (esim_1gb + ins_basic), reference code generated (DV-VE798511), bundle discount 284 TRY, linked order created (SV-XNQ60KJQ)
GET /api/applications/track - timeline with 5 steps (received, payment, documents, processing, result), states correct (done, current, pending), all required fields present
POST /api/admin/applications/{id}/visa-document - valid PDF uploaded with all required fields (file_id, filename, uploaded_at, sent_at, send_status, sent_to)
POST /api/payments/checkout - valid request (200, Stripe checkout URL returned)
Frontend: Admin applications list page loads (/admin)
